name: SSA22b-C5 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Lyman-break galaxy SSA22b-C5, seen by Hubble.
label: ssa22bc5-hubble
story: This field holds SSA22b-C5, one of a small sample of Lyman-break galaxies whose gas motions were mapped from the ground. Hubble gave this faint galaxy extra observing time, looking for signs that its tangled motions come from galaxies merging.

claims.text: SSA22b-C5 is a Lyman-break galaxy in the LSD sample at the pointing position
Hubble gave it extra observing time: two orbits per filter, versus one for other targets
Hubble imaging was used to test whether complex velocity fields come from ongoing mergers
